title: white wash cloths
text: white wash cloths. Got these to supplement my cleaning rag supply.  Being white, you can feel free to bleach when necessary.  They are a really good quality in my opinion and I would buy them again. Can't beat the price for the quality.  A nice surprise.  Arrived quickly with other items I ordered (I have prime) and in good condition.  I never hesitate to update my reviews if new info would be useful.
